# Plan: Settings Page UI redesign (design-reviewed)

## Context
This updates the existing account-settings form to match the checked-in
DESIGN.md. The shell, components (Button, Field, InlineStatus, ErrorSummary,
ConfirmationDialog), interaction states, accessibility contract and responsive
behavior already exist and are accepted. The work is closing five documented
visual inconsistencies between the current form and the approved design system,
without visual exploration or component replacement.

Source plan: `PLAN.md`. Design system: `DESIGN.md`. Review: `/plan-design-review`
(text-only, native voice only, per user request).

## Existing product and accepted behavior (inherited, unchanged)
- Single-column settings shell, 640px max width: persistent app navigation,
  page title and description, action group, InlineStatus, Profile and
  Notifications fieldsets. Reuse existing Button, Field, InlineStatus,
  ErrorSummary and ConfirmationDialog; no new component family.
- Description stays verbatim: “Manage your display name, email address, and
  notification preferences.”
- “Account settings” is h1. Profile and Notifications are h2 headings labelling
  their fieldsets via aria-labelledby; no heading level skipped.
- DOM and visual order:
  ```text
  Persistent app navigation
  main: Account settings (h1) + description
    Save | Reset | Cancel | Export
    InlineStatus
    Profile (h2): Display name, Email
    Notifications (h2): Weekly digest, Product tips
  ```
- Profile: Display name (text), Email (email). Notifications: Weekly digest and
  Product tips switches. New-account defaults: account name/email, Weekly digest
  on, Product tips off. Labels and order fixed. Initial load uses the existing
  form skeleton; read failure shows Retry (aria-label “Retry loading”).
- InlineStatus: role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-atomic=true. After success:
  “Saved at HH:mm” (local 24-hour, existing formatter). Editing away from saved
  values: “Unsaved changes” (text, never color alone). Reverting all edits or
  confirming Reset restores the last save timestamp. Before first successful
  save: blank status; editing shows “Unsaved changes”; revert/Reset restores
  blank. Failed saves keep “Unsaved changes” beside the error.
- Save is atomic. Validation errors appear beside fields and in the linked
  ErrorSummary (aria-describedby); focus the first invalid field. Network
  failure preserves edits and shows Retry in the status area. Retry is a
  sibling button outside the live region; visible text “Retry”, aria-label
  “Retry save” / “Retry export”.
- Pending rules: repeat Save disabled while pending. Save and Export mutually
  exclusive; Reset and Cancel disabled while either is pending; all four
  re-enable on settle. Export uses the existing inline spinner beside
  “Exporting…” inside its disabled button, aria-busy=true, reduced-motion
  aware. After Save finishes, Export downloads the latest successfully saved
  preferences as JSON. Export failure uses the same error/retry area, keeps
  unsaved fields; Retry repeats Export; success clears only the Export error.
- Reset restores saved values after confirmation. Dialog: “Discard unsaved
  changes?” / “Your saved preferences will be restored.” Actions “Keep editing”
  (default) and “Discard changes”. Cancel navigation uses the same dialog with
  “Keep editing” (default) and “Discard and leave”. Dialogs trap focus; Escape
  cancels; closing while staying returns focus to the Reset/Cancel trigger;
  confirmed navigation uses the existing destination-main-heading focus.
- Responsive: above 640px header actions in one row. At 640px and below:
  full-width Save first, then Reset/Cancel/Export in one equal-column row,
  DOM/tab order preserved, fits 320px with 44px targets, no horizontal scroll.
- A11y: 44px targets everywhere; visible focus-visible = existing 2px solid
  #1d4ed8 outline, 2px offset on white (measured contrast above 3:1) on every
  control and dialog action; semantic fieldsets/labels/main landmark; respect
  reduced motion; Export remains a clearly labelled button.
- Font family stays the existing system-ui, sans-serif, inherited by form
  controls (explicit scope decision in PLAN.md; not reopened by this review).

## Design gaps under review (PENDING — no remedy approved yet)
Each gap below is a documented violation of DESIGN.md. The proposed remedy is a
recommendation, not a decision. Each needs its own approval before it moves
into Implementation Tasks.

| # | Gap (current form) | Proposed remedy (DESIGN.md) | Status |
|---|--------------------|-----------------------------|--------|
| 1 | Visual hierarchy: Save renders identically to Reset/Cancel/Export; no visible primary action | Save is the only filled primary button (#1d4ed8, white text); Reset/Cancel/Export are neutral ghost buttons | APPROVED (D2 → 1A) |
| 2 | Motion: Save takes 2-5s with no loading indicator; page looks frozen | Existing pending pattern: inline spinner beside “Saving…” inside the disabled Save button, aria-busy=true, reduced-motion aware | PENDING |
| 3 | Typography: form labels use 14px, 16px and 18px | Two roles only: 16px body/labels/helper text, 20px h2 section headings | PENDING |
| 4 | Spacing: section gaps are 16px, 24px and 32px with no rhythm | 8px base scale: sections 32px, field groups 24px, label-to-input 8px | PENDING |
| 5 | Color: error message is red on light pink at ~3:1, below WCAG AA | error.text #991b1b on error.surface #fef2f2 (~7.6:1) with icon and explicit text | PENDING |

## Implementation Tasks
_Populated only with individually approved remedies. Nothing approved yet._

## NOT in scope
_To be written after the review passes._

## What already exists
_To be written after the review passes._
